summary: Completed the authentication UI with registration, login, session-scoped JWT storage, authenticated task requests, sign-out, and 401 recovery.

messages.content: Frontend auth integration is complete: users can register/login, the JWT is kept only in sessionStorage, task requests carry a Bearer token, sign-out clears it, and 401 responses return users to the sign-in UI.

decisions: Stored only the JWT in sessionStorage; user display details remain in page memory rather than persistent browser storage.
Kept the edit dialog open if a task-save request fails, addressing the prior QA UX observation.
